title: Alinear supply genérica ready con la selección compacta del claim-frontier
mission: Repair the bounded claim-frontier candidate-selection layer so already-eligible generic repository-capable work can actually reach pooled /w workers instead of being hidden behind specialized candidates while the capability-aware metabolism signal still reports FRONTIER_THIN. Start from the exact PROD-01 snapshot and named ready generic jobs; patch only if selection/suppression is inconsistent, preserve deterministic ordering/sharding and fail closed rather than resurrecting terminal or ineligible work.
definition_of_done: Using the exact PROD-01 claim-frontier snapshot generated at 2026-09-21T00:08:49.326Z, trace why named generic ready jobs such as EFF034 runtime observation, EFF060 ratchet reconcile and the v3.30 transport-boundary contract are included or omitted from the compact candidates array.

If an eligible generic job is omitted solely because bounded candidate selection is crowded by specialized-capability work, patch the compiler/selection rule so generic-compatible supply and the compact sharding surface cannot diverge in that way.
Do not reactivate terminal, superseded, dependency-blocked or actively owned jobs; every exclusion must remain deterministic and explainable.
Preserve specialized candidates, capability metadata, atomic claim authority, the three-attempt base ceiling, POOL tail rescue and deterministic beacon-seeded sharding.
Add a regression fixture matching the observed mixed-capability PROD-01 shape and prove generic-ready work remains reachable without treating specialized work as generic.
Keep output within the compact frontier transport budget and do not change Current, Human Accepted, Served or product-page authority.
